rule: Prefer MARKET entries. LIMIT only within 0.8% of mark (never >1.5%); cancel unfilled limit + its SL/TP algos after ~2h or at US-data blackout, not after one scan.

setups.RETEST (CORE + MAO HIEM): One of last 8 closed 1h candles closed beyond prior 20h high/low; price ran >=0.5 ATR, then mark came back within 0.8% of the broken level on the breakout side, with no close back through it by >0.3%. Entry MARKET if within 0.3% of level, else LIMIT at the level (+/-0.05%). SL beyond min/max(retest swing, level) + 0.4xATR(1h,14). TP1 ~1.5R or break-candle extreme (if 1-2R). TP2 = next structure (hi48/lo48 or measured move = range height), capped 4R. Score: 2.5 base, +1 4h-trend aligned (CORE -0.5 if counter-trend), +0.5 break vol>=1.5x, +0.5 clean hold, +0.3 at level.
setups.BREAKOUT: Last closed 1h beyond prior 20h range. MARKET. SL beyond level/3-bar swing + 0.4xATR. TP2 = next structure (not the old range edge). CORE: skip chase if range pos >0.88/<0.12. MAO HIEM: skip only if >1.5xATR past level.
setups.MOMENTUM (MAO HIEM only): No break needed: 4h trend aligned, last 1h vol >=1.5x avg, mom3 >0.5% in trend direction. SL beyond 5-bar swing + 0.3xATR; TP2 = hi20/hi48 (lo20/lo48).

hard_rules: R:R to TP2 >= 2.0; risk per trade = 1% of live walletBalance for BOTH books (A4, replaces CORE 2.0 USDT / MAO HIEM 15%), qty always rounded DOWN to stepSize, never upsized; skip if qty < minQty or notional < MIN_NOTIONAL (SKIP_min_notional); CORE <=10x, MAO HIEM <=20x isolated (lev auto-lowered so liq is beyond SL); SL distance >= 1.0 x ATR(14,1h) for all setups (A3, SKIP_sl_lt_1atr); 1 pos per book, 2 total; daily stop = max(-7.5, -3 x per-trade risk) USDT realized (A7, Saigon day); no entries in US-data windows (weekday 19:30-21:00, 21:30-22:30 Saigon); 2 TPs 50/50 via Algo API MARK_PRICE reduceOnly.
script: /workspace/trade/run_hourly.py places orders itself when run plain; --dry-run simulates all writes (no orders, no Telegram, output -> _dry_run.json).
